title: S.E.M 2026
subtitle: Eight-Week ATHX 2026 Performance Programme
level: Intermediate / experienced eight-week peak; BUILD alternatives and readiness scaling supported.
purpose: Peak an already-training athlete for the published ATHX 2026 Strength, Endurance and MetCon X workouts over eight weeks.
tagline: Strong enough to lift. Fit enough to keep moving. Prepared to do both when it counts.
independent_disclaimer: S.E.M. 2026 is produced independently by SEVEN3SEVEN. It is designed for athletes preparing for ATHX but is not produced, approved or endorsed by ATHX. The latest official workout page, movement standards, athlete briefing and judge instructions always override this programme.

weeks.title: Establish the standard
weeks.checkpoint: Record honest baselines, choose safe training loads and make every repetition legal.

sessions.title: Strict press baseline + upper pull
sessions.purpose: Establish a legal press marker and build upper-back support.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 8-12 min easy SkiErg or row, shoulder prep and progressive empty-bar presses.
blocks.standard: Front rack and overhead positions must feel stable before loading.

blocks.name: Strict press
blocks.instruction: Work to 1 × 3 at RPE 8, then 3 × 5 at RPE 7.
blocks.standard: No dip, bounce, knee bend or press-out. Only legal reps count.

blocks.name: Upper pull
blocks.instruction: 4 × 8-10 ring rows or chest-supported rows.
blocks.standard: Keep shoulders packed and finish every rep under control.

blocks.name: Support
blocks.instruction: 3 × 12-15 lateral raises and 3 × 15-20 band pull-aparts.
blocks.standard: Accessory work supports the lift. It should not create fatigue that affects the next session.

sessions.coach_note: Leave one clean rep available unless the session says otherwise. Strong legal attempts beat ugly max attempts.

readiness_adjustment.average: Use the lower end of the load range. Remove one accessory set.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Reduce strength load 5-7.5%, remove a back-off set, cut accessories in half.

sessions.title: Run-row repeatability baseline
sessions.purpose: Find sustainable category rhythm without a max test.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 10-12 min easy run/row, drills and 3 × 20 sec relaxed pickups.
blocks.standard: The warm-up should make the first rep feel controlled.

blocks.name: Run-row rounds
blocks.instruction: Complete 4 rounds of your category run distance plus your category row distance. Walk easily for 2 min after each round. Lite 500m, ATHX 750m, Pro 1km. RPE 7-7.5.
blocks.standard: Target repeatability. If pace collapses, the first reps were too hot.

blocks.name: Cool-down
blocks.instruction: 8-10 min walk, easy row and calves/lats mobility.
blocks.standard: Leave breathing settled and legs ready for the next session.

sessions.coach_note: The endurance score is not just fitness. It is pacing, transitions and the ability to avoid panic.

readiness_adjustment.average: Drop RPE to 7. Add 30 sec rest.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Cut to 3 rounds at RPE 6-7.

sessions.title: Back squat baseline + lower support
sessions.purpose: Find a legal triple marker and build lower-body positions.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 10-15 min bike or row, hips/ankles, bodyweight squats and progressive barbell sets.
blocks.standard: Depth must be repeatable before load increases.

blocks.name: Back squat
blocks.instruction: Work to 1 × 3 at RPE 8, then 3 × 5 at RPE 7.
blocks.standard: Hip crease below the top of the knee. Stand tall before re-racking.

blocks.name: Lower support
blocks.instruction: 3 × 8 split squats or reverse lunges per leg at RPE 7, then 3 × 8 hamstring curls or RDLs.
blocks.standard: Support work builds the lift without making Saturday heavy.

blocks.name: Flush
blocks.instruction: 6-8 min easy bike and lower-body mobility.
blocks.standard: Finish better than you started.

sessions.coach_note: A squat triple only matters if it would pass judging. Depth and control are part of the score.

readiness_adjustment.average: Lower end of range, one fewer back-off.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Reduce squat load 5-7.5%, drop a back-off set, cut accessories.

sessions.title: Full-movement standards EMOM
sessions.purpose: Introduce every 2026 MetCon movement with enough rest to protect official standards.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 10-12 min easy SkiErg, joint prep and one light official-standard pass through every movement.
blocks.standard: The first work set should feel prepared, not surprising.

blocks.name: 28-min EMOM
blocks.instruction: 4 rounds: min 1 SkiErg 8-12 cal; min 2 GTOH 6-8; min 3 sandbag carry 15-20m; min 4 box 6-8 reps; min 5 lunge 10-15m; min 6 BBJ 5-7m; min 7 rest.
blocks.standard: Use the official 2026 movement standard and record every no-rep risk.

blocks.name: Load level
blocks.instruction: Use L1-L2. Leave at least 15 seconds each working minute. Reduce reps before a standard disappears.
blocks.standard: Turn the lesson into one written decision.

blocks.name: Review
blocks.instruction: Write the movement that limited output and one specific fix.
blocks.standard: Record the result before leaving the session.

sessions.coach_note: The opening week must expose the complete event, not quietly omit the burpee broad jump.

readiness_adjustment.average: Reduce each minute's volume by 20%.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Cut to 3 rounds (18 min).

sessions.title: Deadlift baseline + station flow
sessions.purpose: Find a legal five-rep marker and practise low-pressure transitions.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 10-12 min easy machine, hinge prep and progressive deadlift sets.
blocks.standard: Brace, wedge and lockout should be automatic.

blocks.name: Deadlift
blocks.instruction: Work to 1 × 5 at RPE 8, then 3 × 5 at RPE 7.
blocks.standard: Conventional stance, arms straight, no bouncing, no straps.

blocks.name: Integrated rounds
blocks.instruction: 2-4 controlled rounds: 8-12 cal SkiErg, 6 GTOH, 15-20m carry or lunge. Keep RPE 7.
blocks.standard: Connect strength to competition movement without turning Saturday into a race.

blocks.name: Cool-down
blocks.instruction: 8-10 min easy walk or bike and hips/lats mobility.
blocks.standard: Leave enough in the legs to absorb the week.

sessions.coach_note: Deadlift success in ATHX is strength plus patience. Grip, lockout and legal rhythm matter under the clock.

readiness_adjustment.average: Lower end of range. Cut integrated to 2 rounds.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Reduce deadlift 5-7.5%, drop a back-off, skip integrated.

sessions.title: Optional Zone 2 + official briefing
sessions.purpose: Support recovery and complete the education decision that belongs to this phase.

blocks.name: Easy work
blocks.instruction: 20-35 min easy aerobic work at RPE 2-4.
blocks.standard: This work must improve the next core session.

blocks.name: Education
blocks.instruction: Read the official 2026 workouts and movement standards. Confirm category, sex and format.
blocks.standard: Turn the lesson into one written decision.

blocks.name: Mobility
blocks.instruction: 8-10 min easy range for calves, hips, thoracic spine, lats and shoulders.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Write current readiness and the single decision taken from the session.
blocks.standard: Record the result before leaving the session.

sessions.coach_note: Optional means optional. Skip it when complete rest is the better performance decision.

readiness_adjustment.average: Shorten Zone 2 by 10 min.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Skip and rest fully.

sessions.title: Run-row repeat intervals
sessions.purpose: Build repeatable pace on both scored modalities rather than overloading only the rower.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 10-12 min easy run/row, drills and 3 × 20 sec relaxed pickups on each modality.
blocks.standard: The first work set should feel prepared, not surprising.

blocks.name: Main set
blocks.instruction: BUILD / STANDARD / PERFORMANCE: 4 / 5 / 6 rounds of 500m run + 500m row. Rest 90 sec after each row. RPE 7.5-8.
blocks.standard: Hold repeatable segment pace and complete the required distance before changing modality.

blocks.name: Category finish
blocks.instruction: Complete one controlled final segment at your event distance: Lite Pairs 500m, ATHX 750m or Pro 1km. Use the weaker modality and stay below RPE 8.
blocks.standard: Hold repeatable segment pace and complete the required distance before changing modality.

blocks.name: Cool-down
blocks.instruction: 8-10 min easy movement and record all splits.
blocks.standard: This work must improve the next core session.

sessions.coach_note: The event scores run and row together. Training should not let one modality hide the other.

readiness_adjustment.average: Drop RPE by half a point. Add 30 sec rest.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Cut volume by one round at RPE 6-7.

sessions.title: Sub-maximal official strength sequence
sessions.purpose: Practise the exact 0-6 / 6-12 / 12-20 competition windows without attempting maximal loads.

blocks.name: Warm-up
blocks.instruction: 12-15 min general warm-up and progressive preparation for all three lifts. Write attempts before the clock starts.
blocks.standard: The first work set should feel prepared, not surprising.

blocks.name: 0-6 min: strict press
blocks.instruction: Build to one legal successful single at RPE 8. Use the official no-leg-drive standard.
blocks.standard: Only legal successful repetitions count. No missed reps in normal training.

blocks.name: 6-12 min: back squat
blocks.instruction: Build to one legal successful triple at RPE 8. Keep the bar on the back until all three reps are complete.
blocks.standard: Only legal successful repetitions count. No missed reps in normal training.

blocks.name: 12-20 min: deadlift
blocks.instruction: Build to one legal successful five at RPE 8. Use conventional stance, no straps, no bounce and no more than five seconds between reps.
blocks.standard: Only legal successful repetitions count. No missed reps in normal training.

blocks.name: Record
blocks.instruction: Log every attempt, plate-change delay, no-rep risk and revised opener.
blocks.standard: Record the result before leaving the session.

sessions.coach_note: A rehearsal should reproduce the decisions and time windows that will actually be scored.

readiness_adjustment.average: Lower end of range. Drop one accessory set.
readiness_adjustment.heavy: Reduce main load 5-7.5%, drop a back-off, cut accessories.

programme_rules: Complete five ordered core sessions each week; optional recovery/education is logged separately.
BUILD uses the lowest rep/round count or labelled replacement, STANDARD the middle and PERFORMANCE the highest when supplied.
Only legal successful strength reps count in training.
Progress station work in order: standard, volume, load, density.
Do not cram missed hard sessions or add them to Week 4, Week 7 or race week.
Week 6 contains the final three major zone rehearsals; none is repeated afterward.
The latest official ATHX 2026 page, athlete briefing and judge instructions override cached content.

readiness.title: Readiness and missed sessions
readiness.summary: Use one of four readiness states to protect the purpose of the session without forcing inappropriate work.

states.average: Use the lower load/RPE or interval count and remove one accessory set.
states.heavy: Reduce strength load 5-10% and interval/circuit volume about 20%.
states.pain_changes_movement: Stop the painful movement. Use a pain-free alternative or end the session.

readiness.missed_session_rule: Continue with the next priority session. Never cram two demanding sessions or add missed work to the deload/taper.

strength.individual_score: Total weight lifted across the three components.
strength.pairs_score: Total weight lifted by the pair.

endurance.score: Total distance completed across run and row.

lite.status: No Lite Individual distance listed on the official workout page.

pairs.start_rule: Athlete A starts by running; Athlete B starts on the rower. Swap after the runner completes the category distance.

metcon_x.score: Time to complete inside the 25-minute cap.

lite.status: No Lite Individual prescription listed on the official workout page.

pairs.split_rule: Reps may be split as desired except the sandbag carry is 30m per athlete.
pairs.mixed_rule: Female box height and female lunge dumbbells for both athletes. GTOH and sandbag use each athlete's prescribed sex load.

load_levels.L1: 40-55% event load - learn standards and transitions.
load_levels.L4: 100% published category load - short exposure, rehearsal and race.

content_policy.update_trigger: Re-check before every event and when ATHX changes a workout, standard or athlete briefing.
content_policy.archive_rule: Preserve S.E.M. 2026 and S.E.M. 2027 as separate programmes and keep historical results recoverable.
